info.title: Buncrawl API
info.description: Scrape, crawl and map websites into clean Markdown, HTML, links, screenshots and structured JSON. Send your `BUNCRAWL_API_KEY` as a Bearer token. Firecrawl v2-compatible endpoints live under `/v2`; see the Firecrawl compatibility guide.

servers.description: Your buncrawl server (enter its URL if remote)

tags.name: Crawl
tags.description: Follow links from a start page and scrape every page.

tags.name: Artifacts
tags.description: Screenshots and large content from job results.

post.description: Fetches one page and returns it in the requested formats. JavaScript-heavy pages are rendered in a browser when `renderJs` is `auto` (the default) or `true`.

400.description: The request or URL is invalid (`INVALID_JSON`, `INVALID_REQUEST`, `INVALID_URL`, `BLOCKED_DESTINATION`).

502.description: The page could not be fetched (`DNS_RESOLUTION_FAILED`, `FETCH_FAILED`, `INVALID_REDIRECT`, `TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS`, `RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE`).

503.description: A browser was needed and none is available (`RENDERER_UNAVAILABLE`).

post.description: Starts a background job that follows links from `url` within the same site, respecting robots.txt, and scrapes each page with `scrapeOptions`.

429.description: The server's job queue is full (`QUEUE_FULL`).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job ID returned when the job was submitted.

get.description: The job's state and progress, and one page of its items. Follow `next` until it is absent; a page also stops at 1 MiB of items. Screenshots and content of 64 KiB or more appear as `artifact://<key>` references; download them from `/v1/artifacts/{key}`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Index of the first item to return.

200.description: The job and a page of its items.

404.description: No job of this kind has this ID (`JOB_NOT_FOUND`).

delete.description: Cancels queued items at once. The job is `cancelled` when nothing was running, else `cancelling` until running items finish. A finished job keeps its state.

404.description: No job of this kind has this ID (`JOB_NOT_FOUND`).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job ID returned when the job was submitted.

get.description: Server-sent events. The stream opens with a `snapshot` event (the job's `state` and `progress`), then sends each stored event with its sequence as the SSE `id`; each event's data is a `JobEvent`. Resume with `Last-Event-ID` or `?after=`. The stream closes after the job finishes.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Resume after this event sequence. `Last-Event-ID` does the same.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The last event sequence received, to resume a stream.

200.description: An event stream; each event's data is a `JobEvent` (see components).

400.description: Invalid job ID or event ID (`INVALID_JOB_ID`, `INVALID_EVENT_ID`).

404.description: No job of this kind has this ID (`JOB_NOT_FOUND`).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The key from an `artifact://<key>` reference in a job result.

get.description: A screenshot or large page content referenced from a job result, with its original content type. Responses are sandboxed so stored HTML never runs scripts.

502.description: The artifact store could not be read (`ARTIFACT_STORE_FAILED`).

get.description: The report of the server's startup check: which browsers it found, their versions, and what they can do.

Unauthorized.description: The server requires an API key and none, or a wrong one, was sent (`UNAUTHORIZED`).

url.description: The page to scrape: an `http` or `https` URL.

formats.description: What to return, each format at most once.

renderJs.description: `auto` renders in a browser only when the page needs JavaScript; `true` always renders; `false` never does.

onlyMainContent.description: Keep only the main content, without navigation, headers and footers.

waitForMs.description: Extra time to let a rendered page settle, in milliseconds.

timeout.description: Deadline for the whole scrape, in milliseconds.

maxAge.description: Accept a cached result up to this many milliseconds old; `0` always scrapes fresh.

storeInCache.description: Save the result for later `maxAge` requests.

webhook.description: Where to POST the job's events, signed with `secret`.

maxDepth.description: How many path segments below the start URL to go.

maxBytes.description: Most content to download in total, in bytes.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline for the whole crawl, in milliseconds.

pathPrefix.description: Stay under the start URL's path; `false` crawls the whole site.

scrapeOptions.description: Scrape options for every page: the fields of `ScrapeRequest` without `url`.

webhook.description: Where to POST the job's events, signed with `secret`.

maxDepth.description: How many path segments below the start URL to go.

maxBytes.description: Most content to download in total, in bytes.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline for the whole map, in milliseconds.

pathPrefix.description: Stay under the start URL's path.

webhook.description: Where to POST the job's events, signed with `secret`.

requests.description: The pages to scrape, each a full `ScrapeRequest`.
